'''Premiere &ndash; Cloud City''' (display name '''Premiere - Cloud City''') is a constructed environment whose legal pool is the printed Decipher sets from [[Premiere]] through [[Cloud City]] (including [[Dagobah Limited|Dagobah]]).

The [[1997 Decipher World Championship]] in Norfolk, Virginia was played in this format.

== Deck size ==
{| class="wikitable"
! Default deck size on [[GEMP]]
| 60 cards
|}
